tasks.instruction:
Create two alternative endings for the scene using the existing coverage (focus on blocks b5–b6 and the inserts S16–S21). Deliver two cut variants: 

Variant A — Quiet aftermath: emphasize the hand/key aftermath and rain. Use S16 (insert MS of the key in Dinu's palm) as a held picture after the handoff, then cut to S17 (Dinu CU reaction) and S18 (MCU on Dinu as rain hits). Trim or extend takes as needed to let silence and ambience register (longer holds on S16 and S18). Keep sound minimal: raise ambience (rain) under the S16 hold, minimal dialogue under. End on S18 or S21 (the close insert) with a gentle audio fade on rain.

Variant B — Tense ambiguity: emphasize interpersonal tension and uncertainty about the deal. Skip or shorten the S16 still insert; instead cut from S15/S14 into S19 (two-shot of both) to show their shared complicity, then to S20 (Nimal reaction CU) to underline threat/pressure, then finish on S17 or S21 as a tight, unresolved close on Dinu. Timing should be tighter (shorter holds) to create urgency; add a slight increase in diegetic sound (rain rhythm or a metallic creak) under the final frames to heighten unease.

For both variants: provide one-cut timings and an alternate timing map (take lengths for final cut), show which shots are lengthened/shortened and any re-ordering (order). Also supply camera notes if a tighter close or a faster cut is suggested (camera). Deliver two finished cut lists (shot order + take lengths) and a short audio plan (sound) for each variant.
